cohort: Patients with occipital encephalocele (OE) and microcephaly who underwent either intrauterine or postnatal surgical repair, with inclusion criteria including gestational age between 19 and 27 weeks and maternal age >= 18 years.
finding: Intrauterine repair of occipital encephalocele (OE) was associated with microcephaly reversal and better neurocognitive outcomes compared to postnatal repair.
